opportunities.name: Look up NPS park info by state
opportunities.description: On nps.gov, use 'Find a Park by State' to open the parks for a given {state}, then open a given {section/park} page (e.g. a heritage area, Current Conditions, Basic Information).
steps: Click the link for the target state
Click the target park, park category, or info section link (e.g. 'Current Conditions »', 'Basic Information »')
Read or extract the page content

opportunities.name: Track a Megabus by service number
opportunities.description: On us.megabus, open 'Check my bus' → 'Track my bus', search by {service number}, pick the {stop/city} and click 'Find my bus'.
steps: Type the service number into 'Search by Service Number'
Select the matching stop or city from the suggestions
Click 'Find my bus' and read the status

steps: Go to the events or Special Events & Experiences listing (choose the city if needed)
Pick the ticket quantity in the tickets dropdown
Pick a time slot or click 'Book Now' for the ticket type
